# C152 高音域の比較試験 / 2026-11-11
# この末尾の専用セルだけを使う。以前の結果は変更しない。
from google.colab import files
uploaded_band = files.upload()
# 入力照合と環境準備
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, io, json, subprocess, sys, zipfile
blob = uploaded_band['irodori-mf07-band-input-20261111-v1.zip']
assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest() == '2fea7d73378582ba766addb7a237fcdac3b33e043848a9a12f8fcffd72ea7edb'
band_root = Path('/content/sumi_mf07_band_20261111')
band_root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
band_input = band_root/'input'
band_input.mkdir()
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(blob)) as archive:
    assert all((band_input/n).resolve().is_relative_to(band_input.resolve()) for n in archive.namelist())
    archive.extractall(band_input)
checks = json.loads((band_input/'SHA256.json').read_text())
for name, expected in checks.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((band_input/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
print('BAND_INPUT_VERIFIED',len(checks),len(blob))
band_setup_log = band_root/'setup.log'
with band_setup_log.open('x') as stream:
    band_setup = subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','1200s',sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','torch==2.10.0','numpy==2.2.6','scipy==1.15.3'],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('SETUP_STARTED',band_setup.pid)
# 環境準備の終了を確認
print('SETUP_RETURN_CODE',band_setup.poll())
print(band_setup_log.read_text()[-2000:])
# 同じ初期値・seed・データ・2000回の更新で2条件を比較
assert band_setup.poll() == 0
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(band_input),'-p','test_*.py','-v'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'],check=True)
driver = r"""from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys, time
root=Path('/content/sumi_mf07_band_20261111')
source=root/'input'
start=time.monotonic()
for condition in ['baseline','bands']:
    output=root/condition
    with (root/(condition+'.log')).open('x') as log:
        subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u',str(source/'train_decoder.py'),'--data',str(source/'data'),'--initial',str(source/'initial.pt'),'--output',str(output),'--device','cuda','--objective',condition,'--steps','2000','--max-seconds','240'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=300)
    record=json.loads((output/'completed.json').read_text())
    print('CONDITION_COMPLETE',condition,record['best_step'],record['validation_loss'],flush=True)
(root/'comparison_complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'conditions':['baseline','bands'],'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'quality_verified':False,'firmware_changed':False},indent=2))
print('BAND_COMPARISON_COMPLETE',flush=True)
"""
with (band_root/'driver.py').open('x') as stream: stream.write(driver)
band_driver_log = band_root/'driver.log'
with band_driver_log.open('x') as stream:
    band_process = subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','620s',sys.executable,'-u',str(band_root/'driver.py')],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('BAND_COMPARISON_STARTED',band_process.pid)
# 比較学習の状態
print('COMPARISON_RETURN_CODE',band_process.poll())
print(band_driver_log.read_text()[-2000:])
for condition in ['baseline','bands']:
    log=band_root/(condition+'.log')
    if log.exists(): print(condition,log.read_text()[-1500:])
# 完了した2条件・入力・ログを保存。Macへの退避後にGPU停止。
assert band_process.poll() is not None
print('COMPLETE', (band_root/'comparison_complete.json').read_text() if (band_root/'comparison_complete.json').exists() else 'failed; preserve logs')
band_zip=Path('/content/sumi_mf07_band_results_20261111.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(band_zip,'x',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for item in sorted(band_root.rglob('*')):
        if item.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in item.parts:
            archive.write(item,str(item.relative_to(band_root)))
print('RESULT_ZIP',band_zip.stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(band_zip.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
files.download(str(band_zip))
